sanskrit_verse:
कृतोदकान् समुत्तीर्णान् मृदुशाद्वलसंस्थितान् ।
स्नातान् अपवदेयुस् तान् इतिहासैः पुरातनैः ॥७॥
transliteration: kṛtodakān samuttīrṇān mṛduśādvalasaṃsthitān / snātān apavadeyus tān itihāsaiḥ purātanaiḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who have completed their purification rituals, ascended from the waters, and rested gently upon sacred grass—these bathed ones are to be declared pure by ancient histories.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from completion of prescribed spiritual acts
Causation is established through visible ritual transformation
Restoration logic prioritizes ontological cleanliness over punitive measures
Consciousness alignment occurs through embodied sacramental sequence
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent completes full ablutionary protocol THEN status = purified
IF agent rests on sacred grass after bathing THEN eligibility for testimony = true
IF historical record confirms ritual THEN social validity = restored
IF no bodily contamination detected THEN exclusion clauses = nullified
IF consciousness aligns with dharma THEN punitive consideration = void
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving personal status or ritual eligibility, the court must recognize that completion of Vedic ablutions establishes prima facie purity. Historical and scriptural validation supersedes subjective assessment. The threshold for responsibility lies in observance, not intent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established via sensory confirmation of ritual enactment. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through sequential stages: water contact, emergence, settling on grass, declaration. Responsibility is proportional to observance. There is no punitive consequence; only recognition of completed state.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion verification process: witness attestation + physical evidence of ritual items
Responsibility assumption protocol: individual affirms adherence to prescribed form
Capacity restoration mechanism: integration into community upon verified completion
Integrity reintegration procedure: ceremonial acknowledgment by assembly
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law flows directly from SPH's Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is restored through recognition of completed being. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
